title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes & version bumps
author: Maya Rodriguez
description: Unify authentication, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. This PR consolidates three parallel implementations into a single, specification-driven behavior set: (1) unified token refresh and multi-credential support for hosted and private deployments, (2) consistent retry policy including idempotency detection and backoff caps, and (3) streaming API ergonomics (async iterators in TS & Py, channel-based Go stream helpers) with consistent cancellation and partial-result semantics. Also includes parity fixes discovered during cross-SDK smoke tests and a coordinated minor version bump for all three SDKs. Motivation: customers were observing inconsistent retry windows and missing partial-stream signals between SDKs which caused higher error rates and application complexity. This change reduces cognitive load for engineers using multiple SDKs and enables downstream infra optimizations (shared retry telemetry). The description below summarizes the behavioral changes, migration guidance, and testing performed.
commits: 1) spec/sdk-auth-retry-streaming: add unified SDK spec; 2) python/sdk: implement auth adapter + retry middleware + async streaming iterator; 3) typescript/sdk: adopt auth adapter, unify retry middleware, expose async iterable stream helper; 4) go/sdk: add token refresher interface, retry wrapper, stream helper with context cancellation; 5) tests: cross-sdk integration matrix and add smoke tests for streaming partials; 6) docs: upgrade notes + migration guide; 7) build: bump versions (py 1.12.0, ts 0.9.4, go 0.8.2)
review_comments: Ethan Kim (reviewer): Nicely scoped. Please ensure the TS iterator handles mid-stream cancellations from AbortSignal consistently with Python's async iterator throw(). Also can we add a small benchmark for token refresh latency?

Maya Rodriguez (author): Added AbortSignal support and updated TS iterator to map abort to a graceful close event. Added a microbenchmark for token refresh in ci/sdks-pipeline.yml; results are printed to build artifacts.
Sofia Martinez (reviewer): The retry policy looks good. One request: make the default idempotency detector configurable via SDK options and document the override pattern.
Maya Rodriguez (author): Exposed idempotencyDetector option in all SDK constructors and added documentation + example to docs/sdk-migration.md.
Ravi Patel (reviewer): Go linter flagged an exported helper with mixed case; fixed and re-run. CI failure was flaky test -- re-ran and passed.
Ethan Kim (approver): Approved after addressing comments. Left a follow-up note to track observability tags for retries in ENG-2772.
ci_checks: Pipeline: sdks-unit (pass), sdks-integration (pass), lint (pass after fixes), crosslang-smoke (pass), packaging (pass). One transient failure on sdks-integration caused by an unrelated infra timeout; rerun succeeded. Artifacts: token-refresh-bench.txt, crosslang-streaming-trace.json
merge_details: Merged by squash on 2025-11-20 via GitHub UI. Merge commit message: 'sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics; parity fixes & version bumps\n\nSquashed commits from feature branch.'
release_notes:
- SDKs: Unified auth and retry semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go.
- SDKs: Improved streaming ergonomics and consistent partial-result behavior.
- SDKs: Exposed idempotencyDetector option for custom retry behavior.
- Bumped versions: Python 1.12.0, TypeScript 0.9.4, Go 0.8.2.
- Migration guide: see docs/sdk-migration.md for breaking notes and upgrade steps.
testing_summary: Ran full unit test matrix across CI platforms (py3.10/3.11, node 18/20, go1.20). Added cross-language streaming smoke tests against local devserver and internal canary. Performed manual validation with Redwood hosted and private token flows; verified token refresh under short-lived credentials and load. Observability: added retry and auth spans to opentelemetry traces to validate real-world behavior.
upgrade_instructions: 1) Update SDK dependency to the new version in your project (see release notes). 2) If you used custom retry hooks, switch to idempotencyDetector option or wrap the new retry middleware. 3) For streaming consumers, replace existing stream helpers with the new async iterable/channel helpers; partial-result signals are sent via 'chunk' events and stream close semantics are preserved. 4) Consult docs/sdk-migration.md for code snippets and detailed guidance.
notes: Follow-up work: ENG-2772 (add retry observability dashboards), ENG-2789 (surface SDK-level telemetry in Redwood Console), and a minor patch for an edge-case with Go stream cancellation (tracked as ENG-2831).
